component.name: TypingMaster
component.summary: Learn touch typing with lessons, games and tests

description.p: TypingMaster is a typing tutor that teaches touch typing step by step. Guided courses take you from the home row to fluent typing, and games, reviews and tests keep practice varied.

ul.li: Guided touch typing, speed building and number pad courses
Typing games such as Bubbles, Clouds and Word Tris
Personal review of your difficult keys
Typing tests with detailed results and statistics
Many keyboard layouts and user interface languages

description.p: This package runs the Windows version of TypingMaster using Wine.

screenshot.caption: Touch typing lesson with keyboard and finger guide
Typing games: Bubbles, WordTris, Clouds, ABC Speed Race, Pipe Game and Cloud Race
